text:
[Council File 24-0579]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - LEE) relative to reactivating and restoring Council file No. 24-0579 to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the file's expiration.
Recommendation for Council action:
REACTIVATE and RESTORE the matter of City Charter Section 409 / Special Election / Filling Vacancies / Elected Officials / Amend, as recorded under Council file No. 24-0579, which expired per Council policy (C.F. 05-0553), to its most recent legislative status as of the date of the file's expiration.
summary: Council is reviving an expired file on a City Charter amendment about special elections and filling vacancies for elected officials, restoring it to its last status.
